title: User onboarding and officer usability validation
scope: Create persona onboarding walkthroughs and measure task completion with test participants or scripted proxies

acceptance.text: Create persona onboarding walkthroughs and measure task completion with test participants or scripted proxies
Record observed friction and accessibility issues with prioritized remediation tasks
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR
Follow docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; supply relevant viewport/state screenshots and keyboard/accessibility evidence for human visual review

verification: Record observed friction and accessibility issues with prioritized remediation tasks

evidence.text: Six persona walkthroughs (first-time and keyboard-only taxpayer, new and keyboard-only auditor, supervisor, specialist) in tests/frontend/onboarding.spec.ts, measured by scripted proxy users (tests/frontend/support/proxy.ts) from each portal entrance using only on-screen controls. Completion, actions, Tab stops and Keystroke-Level Model estimates per goal: 17 goals completed at 1440/1024/390 (18/18 walkthroughs); metrics in docs/evidence/TAX-082/metrics. Synthetic data only; no real participants.

docs/evidence/TAX-082/README.md records seven findings with priorities and proposed remediation: F1 P1 auditor search-result click cancelled at >=300 ms latency (8/8 reproduced, cause traced to debounced change + router.replace); F2 P1 supervisors cannot see which cases await their approval; F3 P2 taxpayer landing omits open evidence requests; F4 P2 no specialist referred-to-me view (TAX-093); F5 P2 21/44 Tab stops on review page; F6 P3 showcase in operational nav (TAX-091); F7 tracked by TAX-109. Task creation and owners left to the team lead.

onboarding spec 18/18 passed (Edge, 3 widths); full browser harness 192 passed, 0 failed, 9 skipped (opt-in visual); vitest auditor 100/100, taxpayer 72/72; ESLint, typechecks (auditor, taxpayer, frontend tests), both builds, Ruff, mypy (228 files), Prettier on changed files and validate.py pass. dev.py check fails only on 3 Windows file-mode tooling tests; repo-wide prettier --check flags CRLF checkouts on Windows. CI blocked by org billing.

39 viewport screenshots at 1440/1024/390 (docs/evidence/TAX-082) of each persona's key states including keyboard focus on the dialog confirm and Send response; axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA serious/critical and reflow checks on 12 states found nothing new; keyboard Tab-stop counts per control in metrics/*-keyboard-*.json. Human visual review requested, not assumed.

notes.text: Owner reassigned from Jane to Kananelo by team lead Keletso to balance workload; Jane keeps no open tasks for now.
